name: blixel
description: Rooms, meeting chat, window sharing and transcripts through the blixel CLI.

interface.shortDescription: Rooms, meeting chat, window sharing and transcripts
interface.longDescription: Uses the blixel CLI to create rooms and get their invite links, see who is in a room, post to the current meeting's chat, share windows into it, and search, read, export or follow transcripts recorded on this Mac.
